patterns: is camaraderie the same as friendship
where does the word come from
entries.answer: Camaraderie is the easy solidarity of people doing something hard together, and the word implies the bond comes from the shared work rather than from liking each other first. That is what separates it from friendship, which usually precedes and does not need a common task. English mostly applies it to soldiers, sports teams and emergency crews, all cases where people who would not otherwise meet end up trusting each other quickly.

entries.answer: Goodwill is the general friendly feeling held towards somebody, and it is a countable asset in a way that liking is not, since a business can hold goodwill towards a customer. That accounting sense is what makes the word appear in agreements, where it survives as a payment. In conversation it is what exists before any particular interaction, so a single rude exchange can spend an amount that took months to build.

entries.answer: Encouragement is support offered to somebody who is trying something, and its usefulness depends almost entirely on whether it names the effort rather than the person. Telling somebody you are proud of them reinforces the idea that the outcome was theirs, while noticing the hour they spent on it points at the behaviour. The wrong kind is comparison, which encourages by making the listener measure themselves against somebody else.

patterns: is empathy just saying you understand
entries.answer: Empathy is feeling with somebody rather than for them, and English separates it cleanly from sympathy, which is feeling about their situation from a distance. The word has also been criticised as a vague way of claiming a feeling without doing anything, and the criticism has force, since naming an emotion is not the same as responding to it. What is usually wanted is the observable behaviour underneath it, which is a question and then silence.

entries.answer: Active listening is the practice of giving full attention in order to understand, and the phrase is more specific than listening, which is what the ears do by default. It has three observable parts: not interrupting, paraphrasing what was said, and checking that the paraphrase was right. Only the middle one is hard, and it is the one that surfaces disagreement while the speaker can still fix it, instead of after.

patterns: what is warmth in a person
entries.answer: Warmth is a quality of manner rather than of feeling, and it is the thing people mean when they say somebody was warm. It shows in small measurable choices: noticing who has not spoken, naming people rather than using they, and allowing a pause without filling it. In English it also appears as a noun next to cold, which is where the physical sense survives from old metaphors about temperature.
